offers_products.reason: Makes dental implants, clear aligners, brackets, imaging systems, dental equipment and consumables (Nobel Biocare, Ormco, Kerr, DEXIS).

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from manufactured dental products and equipment; any service or support is incidental to product sales.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells to dental professionals, practices and distributors; patients receive treatment but dentists choose the products.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Buyers are dental practices, labs, DSOs and dental distributors purchasing implants, equipment and consumables.

recurring_revenue.reason: Most sales are implants, orthodontic products and consumables that dental practices reorder repeatedly, outweighing one-off equipment sales.

cyclical_demand.reason: Elective implants, aligners, orthodontics and equipment purchases can be postponed by patients and practices in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Most sales are implants, brackets and consumables bought frequently in small amounts, though imaging equipment is occasional.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for manufactured dental products and technology, not the time of the company's staff.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are individual dental practices and distributors, a fragmented base, though some large DSOs buy.

asset_heavy.reason: Dental product manufacturing needs moderate plants, but it isn't heavy industry or a network; growth relies on brands and R&D.

notes: Distributors and DSOs are mixed in the buyer base, so the large-customer answer is uncertain.
